title: Lots of iced tea: Mandaue woman detained after Balamban mall theft

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A 36-year-old woman may face criminal complaints after allegedly attempting to sneak out of a local shopping mall with thousands of pesos worth of powdered iced tea sachets. The suspect, whom police identified as alias “Belen,” is a resident of Barangay Subangdaku, Mandaue City. Security staff apprehended her in a mall in Barangay Pondol, Balamban, around 7:15 p.m. on Saturday, October 10. According to a report from the Balamban Municipal Police Station, mall personnel caught her carrying 15 dozen plus an additional 13 individual packets of iced tea.
